QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] A Tiny Crack
QuestInfo.0: You've been wandering for hours, but the only Alliance member you managed to find was Azalin. Will you ever find your way out of here?
QuestInfo.1:
Queen Areda of Ariant has Hilla's potion and says something about collecting lives, but you don't understand.
What was Hilla thinking?
QuestInfo.2: As you travel aimlessly through the labyrinth, desperate to find a way out, you can't help but wonder what's happening with the Alliance members and Maple World.
